{{Top|leg}}
'''Customs mandate 142-R4''' was a ruling that gave the [[Thaereian military]] power to inspect [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were leaving the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Thaereian ship ''[[Thaere Runner]]'' ordered the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who were attempting to fly a ship out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]], to comply with the mandate and prepare to have their ship inspected.
